prepare.command: python3 -m pip uninstall -y --break-system-packages d2-python-probe; python3 -m pip show d2-python-probe; test ! -e ~/.local/bin/d2-python-probe && echo D2_PACKAGE_ABSENT_BEFORE
prepare.stderr:
WARNING: Skipping d2-python-probe as it is not installed.
WARNING: Package(s) not found: d2-python-probe

availability.command: for x in python3; do command -v "$x" || true; done

attempt.command: export D2_MARK=/home/alice/d2/markers/pip-module-user; python3 -m pip install --user --force-reinstall --no-index --no-build-isolation --break-system-packages /home/alice/d2/python-package && "$HOME/.local/bin/d2-python-probe"; python3 -m d2_python_probe; python3 -m pip show d2-python-probe
attempt.stderr:
ERROR: Can not perform a '--user' install. User site-packages are disabled for this Python.
/run/current-system/sw/bin/python3: No module named d2_python_probe
WARNING: Package(s) not found: d2-python-probe

observation.command: if test -f /home/alice/d2/markers/pip-module-user; then cat /home/alice/d2/markers/pip-module-user; else echo D2_NO_MARKER; fi; ls -l /home/alice/.local/bin/d2-python-probe 2>/dev/null; find /home/alice/.local/lib -iname "*d2*" 2>/dev/null
